Some sellers are confused initially how to contact and where to contact so this small tutorial is going to be of bit help for them.   Subscribe to My Channel and Get More Great Tips: https://goo.gl/lJ8e17  Ebay is One of the India's largest online shopping website and every seller wants to sell on Ebay online shopping site so it's very important to know how to contact Ebay seller support so that you get desired help when needed. So in this tutorial I have shown how you can contact Ebay seller support and get your queries resolved.  First of all you have to visit www.ebay.in and you will find an option Help & Contact. Once you click on it, you will find an option to select the topic like buying, selling, account, fees and billing. Just select the right option there and you will find different reasons to contact ebay. If you are a seller then you will select selling. Once you click on it, you will see multiple options like getting started, listing items, ebay fees and much more.   Just select the most appropriate one for your issue and then you will be shown with multiple choices to select. If your answer is not shown there then click on contact us shown in blue color right under Need Assistance.  There you will find options to either contact by phone, chat or by email.
